thread:
Samir: Heads-up — AcmeHealth procurement is asking for our SOC 2 Type II report as part of final approval. NDA is signed but they explicitly requested a short-term bridge letter and temporary evidence access while the full report is completed. Can Legal confirm options?

Jen (Legal): We can provide a bridge letter for interim evidence access. Need these before we issue: customer legal name (confirmed as AcmeHealth), scope (production infra only?), expiry window, and confirmation from Security on scoped exclusions. Also tell me if they want a redacted copy vs cover page only.

Emily J: Procurement said they need "evidence for controls" — config snapshots + control matrix + some logs would suffice. They asked for an expected delivery date for the full SOC2 report; estimating ~45 days. Is that reasonable?

Jen (Legal): 45 days is workable. Draft language will say the SOC 2 engagement is underway and expected delivery by a date we supply. We'll draft the bridge to be informational only and include controlled-access instructions.

Ben S: Confirm no scoped exclusions on our side for the requested domain (prod compute, IAM, logging). I'll prepare the evidence set: control matrix, IAM config snapshots, example syslog samples (redacted), and the current readiness attestation. Will generate presigned S3 links with 72h expiry. Please confirm which files they specifically want.

Samir: They listed: (1) control matrix, (2) IAM policy snapshots, (3) sample syslogs (last 7 days), (4) config snapshots for our bastion and proxy. They also want the cover page redacted (no internal IPs or service account names).

Ben S: Understood. I'll redact IPs and service-account identifiers before upload. Also will make sure service account keys/creds are excluded. Generating presigned links now.

sec-bot: Upload complete — presigned access bundle: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-inference-evidence/acmehealth/2025-soc2-evidence?region=us-west-2 (links expire in 72 hours). Audit logging enabled for these objects. :lock:

Emily J: Jen — can you confirm the bridge letter timeframe and send a template we can forward to Acme? We'll attach the presigned bundle in the email.

Jen (Legal): Draft snippet (will refine in Drive):

```
Redwood Inference confirms that a SOC 2 Type II engagement for the period JAN 1 2025 — DEC 31 2025 is in progress. Interim evidence has been made available to AcmeHealth via controlled access for review. Expected delivery of the SOC 2 Type II report is on or before 2025-05-25. This bridge letter is valid for 60 days from issuance and does not constitute an audit opinion or guarantee of future findings.
```

Jen (Legal): Note — I've adjusted expiry to 60 days after we discussed the POC timeline. Will add standard disclaimer about no guarantee and remove any language that implies future fixes.

Samir: 60 days should align with their procurement window. Thank you. Please attach the presigned link and a short access guide (do not download keys).

Jen (Legal): Will attach access guide and include contact for questions (legal@redwood.com). Sending draft to Emily now.

Emily J: Draft received, signed, and emailed to AcmeHealth procurement. cc'd Ben S and Jen (Legal). They acknowledged receipt and said they'll review today.

Ben S: I'll rotate access tokens and make sure the links expire as scheduled. Also enabling more granular bucket audit logs and will share a daily access log with the security mailbox.

sec-bot: Bucket audit logging enabled for redwood-inference-evidence/acmehealth/ — delivery of access logs scheduled every 24 hours to Security. :white_check_mark:

Emily J: Procurement acknowledged the bridge and the presigned bundle — they said this should unblock the contract signature pending their legal review. Will update if they ask for anything extra. Thanks everyone for the quick turn.
